_meta.notes: A01 colour source of truth. Steps are authored in OKLCH (lightness 0..1, chroma, hue degrees); the hexes in docs/art-bible.md are derived from these numbers by tools/palette and must never be hand-edited. One lightness ladder (0.92 / 0.78 / 0.60 / 0.42 / 0.25) across every material so a step number means the same value everywhere; hue drifts warm at the light end and cool in shadow (art-bible pillar 1: light is the hero).
